extraction.Name: Annie Desersa Bonser
extraction.Refused/Protested: Will Tackett called me by phone wanting to buy my land; this is the first I knew I had a patent and I told him I did not want it; I told the Supt. at school that I did not want it; he was the one who gave it to me, it having been mailed to him to give to me.
extraction.Buyer: Sold for $2200.00, paid by notes due every six months, full amount paid
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I had to pay taxes, and I was single at that time, and could not do it, therefore sold it; Borrowed $550 from Walcott and Walcott.
extraction.NOTES: Received patent in 1918 at Genoa, Nebraska at school; did not make application for the patent; not satisfied with the sale of the land as it was worth more; has four children; subscribed and sworn before notary on April 9, 1929; Superintendent referenced is E. E. McKean.
